field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to specs, inputs, stream rows, reductions, attacks, or tests.

field_principles.frontier:future_yield: Future exact yield measures held utility.
field_principles.frontier:precision: Write precision measures accepted exact support.
field_principles.frontier:retention: Protected retention guards prior exact behavior.
field_principles.gate:embedded_tokenizers: All token counts must come from embedded GGUF tokenizers.

field_principles.honest_verdict: Uses a terminal success prefix and states the capacity-frontier result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares task-scoped local GGUF receipt replay with exact-governed memory.
field_principles.manifest_absence_before_run_receipt: Proves the new manifest and artifact paths did not exist before generation.
field_principles.memory_schema_head_and_transition_histor: Records every schema, head, and transition.
field_principles.model_file_and_embedded_tokenizer_hashes: Binds model bytes and embedded tokenizer metadata.
field_principles.models_used: Lists only the three mandated GGUF models.
field_principles.per_capacity_coverage_precision_selectio: Reports separated capacity metrics without pooled masking.
field_principles.per_event_unique_raw_output_and_pre_outc: Proves each event id has one fresh raw output and frozen proposal before outcome release.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Records one comparative future row before aggregate calculation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Lists all gates checked before readiness can become one.
field_principles.preregistered_capacity_and_arm_contract: Freezes capacities, arms, work, prompts, tokens, checkers, and initial heads before outcomes.
field_principles.prospective_write_once_csl_ready_score: Conjunctive readiness score for exact-governed capacity utility.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows protected upstream and ops files stayed byte-identical.
field_principles.protected_leakage_count: Must be zero because protected and future rows cannot route writes.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins event generation, capacities, arms, attacks, and metrics.
field_principles.raw_output_reuse_count: Must be zero because one raw output cannot represent two event ids.
field_principles.reported_vs_recomputed_deltas: Shows reported aggregates match row recomputation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the payload with volatile fields normalized.
field_principles.same_step_write_count: Must be zero because writes follow exact outcomes.
field_principles.status: Names the terminal state for the prospective write-once capacity frontier.
field_principles.task_scoped_process_gpu_runner_and_raw_o: Binds fresh event generation to task-scoped process receipts.
field_principles.tests_run: Records verification commands and exit codes.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Marks only exact feedback, release, and protected-retention checks as oracles.
field_principles.write:Commit: Commits require exact support, valid license, protected retention, unique effect, predecessor freshness, and capacity room.
field_principles.write:Defer: Defers rows before exact support or under frozen authority.
field_principles.write:Evict: Eviction keeps capacity bounded after exact lower-priority selection.
field_principles.write:Expire: Expiry removes records after temporal or license validity ends.
field_principles.write:Quarantine: Quarantine contains malformed or unsafe evidence.
field_principles.write:Reject: Rejects record exact, license, or predecessor failure.
field_principles.write:Supersede: Supersession replaces an older exact effect with newer exact support.
